component.name: Mini Keyboard
component.summary: Native Linux programmer for USB mini macro keyboards

description.p: Mini Keyboard is a native Linux application for discovering, reading, editing, and writing configurations on supported USB mini macro keyboards. It uses GTK 4, libadwaita, and hidapi without Wine or Windows binaries.
Write operations stay gated until protocol mappings are verified against hardware capture vectors. Unknown device variants open in read-only mode.
Initial native Linux release scaffold with capability-gated protocol.
